header: The page's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout counted,
for when a longer play than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile
once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher, and says when it is done; Firefox
builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), Play (pressed until the game has booted), the logos and the
title. tools/shader_survey.js's play(), a need, then loads File 1 from the file select as a player does (making it on
a new profile, its opening cutscene cleared), Link runs about his house, and the pause menu's four pages are turned
there. Every other place is reached by the survey's warp(), as the debug menu's Warp rows do (web/survey.cpp), each a
need that fails the run unless the save's entrance and Link's age are the ones asked for: Lake Hylia as a child, and
as an adult the graveyard and the Desert Colossus, each from the pad its warp song (the Serenade of Water, the
Nocturne of Shadow, the Requiem of Spirit) lands on, clear of the ways out, about 20 s each, with every item (gear())
and his health kept full. In each Link sways out and back about where he arrived with Z held, so he steps without
turning (forward and back, to each side and back), then swings B, targets with Z and holds R up his shield. From Lake
Hylia on, its waits and holds are on the game's own clock, the play state's frame count (20 a second; each new play
state starts it at 0, which the wait after a warp counts from), so every browser walks Link as far whatever frames it
gives the game. A picture of each place is taken as it is reached, about 6 s in for the last three.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|the game waiting for the \d+ of section
start: (() => { try { n64r(0x80000000); return true; } catch { return false; } })()
play: (() => { window.planWaits = {}; window.later = (label, p) => { window.planWaits[label] = p; const say = (text) => setTimeout(() => console.log('[plan] ' + label + ': ' + text), 1000); p.then((v) => say(JSON.stringify(v)), (e) => say(String(e))); return label + ' started'; }; return 'later()'; })()

(() => { const save = 0x80000000 + 0x11A5D0; window.keepAlive = window.keepAlive || setInterval(() => { if (n64r(save + 0x135C) === 0) n64w(save + 0x30, (0x140 << 16) | (n64r(save + 0x30) & 0xFFFF)); }, 250); return 'health kept full'; })()
